items.title: T. Rowe Price Group (TROW) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift As Analysts Rework Models
items.summary: The updated fair value estimate for T. Rowe Price Group has moved from US$97.42 to US$110.00, signaling a higher price target in the latest model refresh. This shift is landing in the middle of recent Street targets that cluster just above US$100 and run up to about US$121, where analysts are weighing solid execution against questions on how much upside is already in the stock. items.summary: Financial providers use their expertise in capital allocation and risk assessment to help facilitate economic growth while offering consumers and businesses essential financial services.
